name: OH in a Madison Ballroom 2023
information: ### 3x3 One-Handed is the main event of the competition, but we will still be holding 3x3, Skewb, and Square-1. We hope to see you at Wisconsin's biggest competition EVER this July! ##### Please read the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OHinaMadisonBallroom2023#27193-faq) if this is your first competition and [contact the organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website?competitionId=OHinaMadisonBallroom2023) if you have further questions. ##### The [Venue Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OHinaMadisonBallroom2023#27194-venue-information) tab contains important Parking, Travel, and Accommodation information for before the competition.
